title: MEV: A Multi-Event Video Dataset for Long-Take Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.38241v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Current datasets for text-to-video generation are largely limited to short clips depicting a single event or coarse-grained captions. As a result, they provide limited supervision for modeling long-take temporal dependencies, often leading to temporally inconsistent generations when describing multiple events. In this paper, we introduce MEV, a multi-event video dataset designed for long-take video generation. MEV provides high-quality real-world videos where subjects can perform a sequence of distinct, non-overlapping events, featuring precise temporal boundaries and fine-grained procedural annotations. This event-centric discretization reduces confounding factors and enables models to support temporally localized conditioning and build long-take videos from atomic event units. translated_title: MEV：用于长镜头生成的多事件视频数据集
translated_abstract: 当前用于文本到视频生成的数据集大多局限于描绘单一事件或粗粒度文本描述的短片段。因此，这些数据集为建模长镜头的时间依赖性提供的监督有限，往往导致在描述多个事件时生成结果在时间上不一致。在本文中，我们提出了MEV，一个专为长镜头视频生成设计的多事件视频数据集。MEV提供了高质量的真实世界视频，其中主体可以执行一系列独特的、互不重叠的事件，并具有精确的时间边界和细粒度的过程性标注。这种以事件为中心的离散化方式减少了混杂因素，使模型能够支持时间局部化的条件控制，并从原子事件单元构建长镜头视频。此外，我们引入了一套全面的标注流程，可将视频分割为时间上有据可依的事件，并生成结构化的文本描述……
tldr: 本文提出了MEV数据集，通过提供具有精确时间边界和细粒度过程性标注的真实世界多事件视频，解决了现有文本到视频数据集难以建模长镜头时间依赖性的问题，支持时间局部化条件控制并从原子事件单元组合生成长镜头视频。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MEV, a multi-event video dataset with high-quality real-world videos featuring precise temporal boundaries and fine-grained procedural annotations, enabling temporally localized conditioning and compositional long-take video generation from atomic event units.
